basic_profile.bio: Avid Warhammer 40k enthusiast and miniature painter from Portland, Oregon. When not engaged in the grimdark future, I'm often found trading stocks or experimenting with new brewing techniques. I work as a software developer by day, which feeds into my passion for technology and innovation. In a committed relationship, my partner and I often share our hobbies, and we are parents to two mischievous cats. My typical online hours are in the late evenings during weekdays and varied on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been a Warhammer 40k player for over a decade, starting with the Thousand Sons faction. My expertise comes from countless hours of gaming and painting, combined with a deep dive into lore through novels and community discussions. My background in software development also keeps me abreast of current tech trends, often shared in subreddits like 808Trading2.
